messages.author: lars.mikkelsen.100227@bluebarn.example
messages.text: Welcome everyone to the task force. Our main job is to put together practical producer testimony for modernizing the raw-milk aging rule before the summer review cycle.

messages.author: otto.bergman.100415@postfield.example
messages.text: Thanks Matteo. I am glad we are tackling this directly because the current sixty-day requirement does not reflect modern pathogen testing or traditional make procedures.

messages.author: chidi.achebe.100676@lakemail.example
messages.text: Tom and I can pull together some moisture and acidity logs from our winter vats to show how microbial stability actually behaves around day thirty.

messages.author: dana.hollis.101448@larkhollowdairysystems.example
messages.text: Make sure we include affineur notes as well. Damien has great data on how rind flora develops over shorter aging windows when humidity is tightly controlled.

messages.author: bjorn.lindholm.100765@homestead.example
messages.text: From the export perspective, aligning our standards with accepted international science will save smaller producers a lot of headaches at the border.

messages.author: lars.mikkelsen.100227@bluebarn.example
messages.text: Good point Suresh. Let us make sure the draft highlights economic impacts on regional cheesemakers who rely on seasonal raw-milk batches.

messages.author: otto.bergman.100415@postfield.example
messages.text: I will synthesize the technical notes from Chidi and Dakota into a working draft outline for our review next month.

messages.author: alec.keane.100747@loamfieldfinecheese.example
messages.text: The framework looks solid. Down here we have similar discussions happening regarding traceability standards for raw milk cheese imports.

messages.author: lars.mikkelsen.100227@bluebarn.example
messages.text: ICF staff let me know the comment portal opens in June, so we are in a great position to finalize our text by the end of next month.

messages.author: otto.bergman.100415@postfield.example
messages.text: I have updated the draft based on feedback from the last call. Please review the specific wording around moisture thresholds.

messages.author: chidi.achebe.100676@lakemail.example
messages.text: The moisture thresholds look accurate to our make sheets. I have no further edits on that section.

messages.author: dana.hollis.101448@larkhollowdairysystems.example
messages.text: Everything reads clearly and professional. Thanks to Damien and Matteo for keeping us on schedule for the submission.

messages.author: lars.mikkelsen.100227@bluebarn.example
messages.text: Our comments have been officially submitted to the standards committee. Thanks to everyone who contributed data and review time.

messages.author: otto.bergman.100415@postfield.example
messages.text: We can archive these notes for now and wait for the agency response expected later in the autumn.
